issues.explanation: CreateQueue performs no create authorization, so employees and non-members can create queues instead of getting AuthorizationException.
UpdateQueue performs no update authorization and has no race handling, so non-managers can update and a slug race escapes as raw QueryException.
CallNextTicket hunk contains an orphaned throw and closing brace after the Gate call, which is a syntax error so the file cannot work.
CreateQueue catches `\\Illuminate\\Database\\QueryException` with doubled backslashes and duplicates the ValidationException import, which is broken PHP.
QueuePolicy::create returns `$membership && ...`, so a non-member returns null/false against a `: bool` return type instead of cleanly denying.
QueuePolicy::call uses whereJsonContains on permissions, so a corrupted non-array value is not handled as a graceful deny as the task requires.
Ticket::call re-queries the queue with firstOrFail without a row lock and duplicates the entity_id lookup instead of using the locked queue.
docs/database-schema.md is not touched in the diff although the task requires updating it for queue_access.
SetQueueAccess checks owner/admin roles manually instead of authorizing through QueuePolicy via Gate, violating policies-for-authorization and single source of truth.
QueueAccess::membership() omits the foreign key, so Eloquent defaults to membership_id instead of entity_membership_id.
The diff adds no Pest/PHPUnit tests for queue lifecycle, access grants, or unauthorized-call paths.
A new AuthServiceProvider with explicit policy mapping is added although the contract requires an auto-discovered QueuePolicy.
Duplicate `use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException` imports and a stale commented import are left in CreateQueue and UpdateQueue.

conventions.evidence: app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:110 manual role check instead of Gate/policy; app/Providers/AuthServiceProvider.php:1 explicit mapping vs auto-discovered; app/Models/QueueAccess.php:244 missing FK; duplicate ValidationException imports; no tests; docs/database-schema.md missing

readability.evidence: app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:54 duplicate ValidationException import; app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:76 `catch (\\Illuminate...`; app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:32 orphaned throw/brace; app/Models/Ticket.php:268 duplicated $entityId lookup

requirements.evidence: app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:60 no authorize call; app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:169 no authorize and no race catch; app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:32 broken hunk cannot parse; app/Models/Ticket.php:271 firstOrFail without lock; docs/database-schema.md absent from diff

scope.evidence: CHANGELOG.md:9, docs/business-rules.md:481, app/Actions/*, app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:1, database/migrations/*queue_access*, database/factories/QueueAccessFactory.php:1 all serve the task; no delete/remove/destroy action added

security.evidence: app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:60 and app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:169 allow unauthorized writes; app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:310 non-member returns non-bool; app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:345 corrupted permissions not graceful deny

simplicity.evidence: app/Providers/AuthServiceProvider.php:1 unnecessary provider when policy should be auto-discovered; app/Models/Ticket.php:268 plus :279 duplicate queue/entity queries; app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:110 duplicated policy logic

tests.evidence: change.diff:1 no tests/* or test files added; no happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call, or tamper coverage

review.summary: Adds queue lifecycle actions, queue_access table/factory, QueuePolicy, and call-path checks, but Create/Update lack authorization, CallNextTicket is syntactically broken, the policy mishandles non-members and corrupted permissions, database-schema docs and all tests are missing, so the change must be rejected.
